name: p30 - 'All Weeks' video and PDF handout open and close
description:
Exercise video and handout where they actually exist.

        p28 drives these types too, but only if the *current* week happens to
        schedule them - and at present no course does, so on its own p28 would
        leave both paths unexecuted. This test reaches them through All Weeks,
        so the video overlay and the PDF tab are genuinely covered rather than
        merely covered on paper.

        Both types are searched for across every course, so this keeps working
        as course content is edited.
